title: Cool off at your neighborhood City pool!
description:
Cool off at one of our city pools, where you’ll find everything from lap swimming and fitness classes to kids’ water polo and free swim lessons for both kids and adults.

Be sure to check our webpage before you head out to check for any pools closed for maintenance and holidays: sandiego.gov/pools.

For more places to cool down, visit sandiego.gov/PlacesToCoolDown.

#CityOfSanDiego #Swim #Pool
